generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: fresh sequential integers, no NULL, unique per table; PK columns are exempt from duplicate-share targets (uniqueness enforced)
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: sample from parent table's generated key values; NULLable FK columns get a NULL share per null_share rule; never emit keys absent from the parent table (FK integrity enforced)
generic_sampling_rules.integer_range: uniform integer within the range rule; no NULL unless the column is in null_targets, then NULL share per null_share rule
generic_sampling_rules.text: short ASCII names from a small pool; 20-50% duplicate share (target midpoint 0.35) for non-key columns; nullable columns get NULL share per null_share rule
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: single value from the listed enum; nullable columns get NULL share per null_share rule
generic_sampling_rules.char: single letter from the enum; nullable columns get NULL share per null_share rule
generic_sampling_rules.text_code: 3-letter uppercase code from a small pool; nullable columns get NULL share per null_share rule
generic_sampling_rules.near_variant: for each listed equality literal, generate a variant by case change, one-character edit, or a single-character typo; these are literal column values, not LIKE patterns
generic_sampling_rules.like_pattern: for each listed '%'-prefixed target, treat it as a LIKE-pattern operand only; do NOT store the '%'-prefixed string as a literal column value
generic_sampling_rules.boundary: for each listed numeric boundary, include the value, value-1, and value+1
generic_sampling_rules.tie: for ORDER BY columns with a tie, include at least two rows with the same value at the listed rank
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: NULL is generated ONLY for columns listed in null_targets; each such column gets at least one NULL row and at least one non-NULL row per instance; share: 5-30% for Faculty_Participates_in.FacID/actid, 0-5% for Participates_in.stuid/actid and Student.Advisor; apply the NULL rule exactly once per column (single Bernoulli draw per row, no double planting); NOT NULL and primary-key columns never get NULL; planted NULLs are never replaced to satisfy a rule
generic_sampling_rules.duplicate_share: for non-key columns with a duplicate-share target, aim for 20-50% duplicate share (midpoint 0.35); report achieved share per column; PK columns are exempt
